Possessive pronouns my / your / his / he: my/your/his/her/its/our/their express belonging and are followed by nouns; do not confuse them with pronoun or contracted forms.本课为综合测试练习,核心:Adjectival possessive pronouns must be followed by nouns; nominal ones stand alone。

my + noun = my things|his/her distinguishes gender but the form is the same for subject and object|their = their, theirs = their things|your can be singular or plural|its means 'something's', it's = it is
This is mine notebook.|This is I notebook.|This is me notebook.|This is my notebook.
column4: Adjectival possessive pronouns must be followed by nouns; nominal ones stand alone。正确句:This is my notebook.

column3: 她每个周末洗自己的衣服。

# title: 「她每个周末洗自己的衣服。」的正确英文是?
Possessive pronouns my / your / his / he: She washes hers clothes every weekend.|She washes she's clothes every weekend.|She washes she clothes every weekend.|She washes her clothes every weekend.
column4: 考查Adjectival possessive pronouns must be followed by nouns; nominal ones stand alone。正确句:She washes her clothes every weekend.
